item.bloodrunes.blank_rune.desc:
§7A barren rock, thirsty fer the blood o' scallywags.§r
§8Drop it upon the Runestone Anvil t' begin yer dark craft.§r
item.bloodrunes.blood_rune.desc:
§7Cursed with wild leviathan vigor.§r
§8Steals life from swabies on each strike!§r
item.bloodrunes.courage_rune.desc:
§7Forged in the fury o' Davy Jones' grasp.§r
§8Deals mighty blows when yer near t' sinkin'.§r
message.bloodrunes.language_learned: Ahoy! Ye've mastered the ancient Viking sea-tongue!
message.bloodrunes.unknown_language: Ye cannot read the ancient seafarin' runes t' craft this booty!
message.bloodrunes.ritual_started: The altar roars like a squall at high seas...
message.bloodrunes.ritual_success: The ritual be finished! Full sail ahead!
item.bloodrunes.uruz_rune.desc:
§7Roarin' with primeval kraken might.§r
§8Grants iron flesh 'n cannonball arms.§r
item.bloodrunes.thurisaz_rune.desc:
§7Fierce strength o' the giant.§r
§8Sends cannonballs right back at the scoundrels!§r
item.bloodrunes.ansuz_rune.desc:
§7Odin's seafarin' cunning.§r
§8Boosts black magic 'n plunder XP.§r
item.bloodrunes.raido_rune.desc:
§7Fair winds in yer sails.§r
§8Speeds yer boots 'n keeps sharks away.§r
item.bloodrunes.gebo_rune.desc:
§7Share the spoils.§r
§8Binds yer crew with iron loyalty.§r
item.bloodrunes.wunjo_rune.desc:
§7Singin' shanties 'n drinkin' rum.§r
§8Heals all mateys nearby.§r
item.bloodrunes.hagalaz_rune.desc:
§7A wrathful maelstrom.§r
§8Calls thunderbolts down upon the enemy deck!§r
item.bloodrunes.nauthiz_rune.desc:
§7Last stand before the locker.§r
§8Strikes with devastating fury when near death!§r
item.bloodrunes.isa_rune.desc:
§7The frozen north seas.§r
§8Freezes scallywags dead in their tracks!§r
item.bloodrunes.jera_rune.desc:
§7Reapin' the ocean's treasure.§r
§8Pays hearty rewards t' patient sailors.§r
item.bloodrunes.eihwaz_rune.desc:
§7Flying Dutchman's curse.§r
§8Sucks the very souls from foes!§r
item.bloodrunes.perthro_rune.desc:
§7Rollin' bones o' destiny.§r
§8Great fortune, but mind the mutiny!§r
item.bloodrunes.algiz_rune.desc:
§7Valkyrie's iron wall.§r
§8No cannonball can pierce ye!§r
item.bloodrunes.sowilo_rune.desc:
§7The blazin' midday sun.§r
§8Burns skeletons 'n drowners t' ash!§r
item.bloodrunes.tiwaz_rune.desc:
§7Captain's sacrifice.§r
§8Slices clean through armor like butter!§r
item.bloodrunes.berkano_rune.desc:
§7Climbin' out of Davy Jones' grasp.§r
§8Cheats death itself!§r
item.bloodrunes.ehwaz_rune.desc:
§7Bond with yer sea mare.§r
§8Ride like the wind across the land.§r
item.bloodrunes.mannaz_rune.desc:
§7Pirate brethren.§r
§8Better trade deals with merchant landlubbers.§r
item.bloodrunes.laguz_rune.desc:
§7Master o' the tides.§r
§8Breathe and rule beneath the waves.§r
item.bloodrunes.ingwaz_rune.desc:
§7Bountiful island soil.§r
§8Grows crops faster than a broadside volley!§r
item.bloodrunes.dagaz_rune.desc:
§7The golden dawn.§r
§8Blinks across the sea instantly!§r
